description: Headless Path of Building (PoE 1) daemon, offline Lua game-data index, and high-SNR CLI for AI agents
pre_install: if (Get-Command pob -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { try { & pob stop 2>$null | Out-Null } catch {} }
notes: Run `pob bootstrap` (or `pob bootstrap --proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890`) once to install the headless PoB engine.
Runtime state and managed engine are stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\pob-agent-tools (override with POB_RUNTIME_DIR).
